turns.prompt: A mechanic at Cobblewheel asked what gear inches describe on a build sheet; the wheel diameter is multiplied by the ratio of chainring teeth to sprocket teeth. One build has a 26 inch wheel, a 48 tooth chainring and a 16 tooth sprocket. Give its gear inches.
